name: mandate0
description: Shop connected stores inside the spending limits you set in mandate0: search, check out, and get the receipt.

interface.longDescription: mandate0 lets ChatGPT and Codex buy physical goods for you from stores connected to mandate0, inside the spending limits you set: which stores, how much per purchase, and a budget. mandate0 enforces the limits on its server. The assistant checks your limits before it shops, asks you before anything outside them, never splits an order to fit under a limit, and gives you the order number and receipt when it is done. New connections use sandbox money until you choose live on the consent screen.
defaultPrompt: What can I spend with mandate0 right now?
Find a 12oz bag of whole-bean coffee in my connected stores.
Buy this product link inside my mandate.

review.commerce_description: Buys physical goods from stores connected to mandate0, inside spending limits the user set. Checkout completes on the store's own commerce system; mandate0 enforces the limits and returns the order number and receipt.
